DATA = {
    "products": [0, 1],
    "machines": [0, 1],
    "periods": [0, 1, 2, 3],
    "setup_cost": 121.0782541217011,
    "startup_cost": 69.65555018358044,
    "holding_cost": {0: 1.196682091019819, 1: 1.146459407730801},
    "backlog_cost": {0: 7.384397449671641, 1: 6.58642780982885},
    "demand": {
        0: {0: 22.28694038228271, 1: 15.40553617195959,
            2: 16.19622794603683, 3: 23.77133167016131},
        1: {0: 16.51020937307772, 1: 15.41395287058592,
            2: 23.98409764196543, 3: 18.84683167137874},
    },
    "capacity": {0: 63.4339018881536, 1: 67.51600987446864},
    "startup_time": {0: 7.917022863645049, 1: 7.682853596177669},
}


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA

    products = d["products"]
    machines = d["machines"]
    periods = d["periods"]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=products)
    model.M = pyo.Set(initialize=machines)
    model.T = pyo.Set(initialize=periods)

    # Decision variables
    model.production = pyo.Var(
        model.M, model.P, model.T,
        within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
    )
    model.setup = pyo.Var(
        model.M, model.P, model.T,
        within=pyo.Binary,
    )
    model.startup = pyo.Var(
        model.M, model.P, model.T,
        within=pyo.Binary,
    )
    model.inventory = pyo.Var(
        model.P, model.T,
        within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
    )
    model.backlog = pyo.Var(
        model.P, model.T,
        within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
    )

    # Objective
    def obj_rule(m):
        setup_terms = sum(
            d["setup_cost"] * m.setup[i, j, t]
            for i in m.M for j in m.P for t in m.T
        )
        startup_terms = sum(
            d["startup_cost"] * m.startup[i, j, t]
            for i in m.M for j in m.P for t in m.T
        )
        holding_terms = sum(
            d["holding_cost"][j] * m.inventory[j, t]
            for j in m.P for t in m.T
        )
        backlog_terms = sum(
            d["backlog_cost"][j] * m.backlog[j, t]
            for j in m.P for t in m.T
        )
        return setup_terms + startup_terms + holding_terms + backlog_terms

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # Inventory / backlog balance per product-period
    def balance_rule(m, j, t):
        t_list = list(m.T)
        idx = t_list.index(t)
        prev_inv = m.inventory[j, t_list[idx - 1]] if idx > 0 else 0
        prev_back = m.backlog[j, t_list[idx - 1]] if idx > 0 else 0
        total_prod = sum(m.production[i, j, t] for i in m.M)
        return (prev_inv - prev_back + total_prod
                - m.inventory[j, t] + m.backlog[j, t]
                == d["demand"][j][t])

    model.balance = pyo.Constraint(model.P, model.T, rule=balance_rule)

    # Machine capacity per period
    def capacity_rule(m, i, t):
        return sum(m.production[i, j, t] for j in m.P) <= d["capacity"][i]

    model.capacity = pyo.Constraint(model.M, model.T, rule=capacity_rule)

    # One product at a time per machine per period
    def one_product_rule(m, i, t):
        return sum(m.setup[i, j, t] for j in m.P) <= 1

    model.one_product = pyo.Constraint(model.M, model.T, rule=one_product_rule)

    # Production only if setup
    def prod_setup_rule(m, i, j, t):
        return m.production[i, j, t] <= d["capacity"][i] * m.setup[i, j, t]

    model.prod_setup = pyo.Constraint(
        model.M, model.P, model.T, rule=prod_setup_rule
    )

    # Startup logic: startup >= setup[t] - setup[t-1]
    def startup_rule(m, i, j, t):
        t_list = list(m.T)
        idx = t_list.index(t)
        if idx == 0:
            return m.startup[i, j, t] >= m.setup[i, j, t]
        else:
            prev = m.setup[i, j, t_list[idx - 1]]
            return m.startup[i, j, t] >= m.setup[i, j, t] - prev

    model.startup_logic = pyo.Constraint(
        model.M, model.P, model.T, rule=startup_rule
    )

    return model

    def setup_link_rule(m, mm, p, t):

    def startup_rule(m, mm, p, t):

        return m.s[mm, p, t] >= m.z[mm, p, t] - z_prev

    model.startup = pyo.Constraint(model.MPT, rule=startup_rule)

    return model

    model.one_product = pyo.Constraint(model.MT, rule=one_product_rule)

    def active_setup_rule(m, mm, t):

    # Startup implies setup
    def startup_setup_rule(m, p, mm, t):
        return m.s[(p, mm, t)] <= m.y[(p, mm, t)]
    model.startup_setup = pyo.Constraint(model.PMT, rule=startup_setup_rule)
